pr.body:
## Summary
- update RTE operator docs so current usage points to the runtime-backed `dopemux rte` command family
- reclassify stale `dopemux upgrades`, `dopemux extractor`, `dopemux truth`, direct runner, v3/v4, and legacy scan references according to runtime evidence
- preserve v5 runtime authority, proof/source-truth separation, and guarded go-live posture without runtime changes

## Scope
- operator docs, active RTE reference/truth docs, task-packet index hygiene, task packet, and proof artifacts
- no runtime code, promptsets, model routing, walker/prescan code, batch clients, strict attestation code, dependencies, live extraction, provider calls, or external batch jobs

## Validation
- task packet/proof JSON parse and task-packet schema validation
- focused grep validations for canonical command claims, legacy classification, v5 authority, proof/source-truth wording, and go-live guardrails
- compileall to confirm no accidental Python damage
- git diff whitespace check and pre-commit on changed files
